title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct escape velocity as a multiple of V.

title: Gravitational Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the gravitational force equations at the pole and equator.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate the use of energy conservation principles to derive the escape velocity.

title: Correct Substitutions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly substitute values for g and GM in the escape velocity equation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the gravitational potential energy calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
